scope: VB CommandButton default, cancel and flat appearance boundary.
actual_source_basis: The original VB5 and VB6 XP Styles Demonstration forms declare cmdOK Default=True and cmdCancel Cancel=True with ordinary CommandButton captions.

The 3Ddefline source declares Appearance=Flat together with Style=Graphical and Picture, so its flat visual path is the already bounded owner-draw graphical CommandButton path, not a public BS_FLAT button style.
renderer_boundary: An exact runtime-owned ThunderRT5/6CommandButton with public BS_PUSHBUTTON or BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON is handled by the existing BUTTON painter. The default border is selected from BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON only while enabled. Cancel remains dialog/runtime command routing, not a button paint or message rewrite. Graphical/flat picture controls remain under S10's ODT_BUTTON/DC scope.

current_witness.x64_injected: VB_COMMAND_DEFAULT_OK attached=1 default_border=1 style_transition=1 disabled=1 keyboard=1 notifications=2
current_witness.x86_injected: VB_COMMAND_DEFAULT_OK attached=1 default_border=1 style_transition=1 disabled=1 keyboard=1 notifications=2
current_witness.native_controls: Both bit widths preserve 11 native click notifications; injection is absent and the fixture's native BUTTON superclass owns the behavior.
current_witness.private_desktop_ctest: core/default and core/vb-controls require a private desktop. This session's CTest driver reached CreateDesktop/SetThreadDesktop and returned ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5), so those CTest cases are recorded as an environment skip; the same self-owned C fixture was exercised directly on its accessible native probe thread.

result: The only safe renderer-side differentiation is the existing BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON border. S23 adds an exact runtime-owned regression for attachment, default-to-push transition, disabled state, Space activation and parent notifications. No production implementation change is needed.
not_covered: Private VB Cancel routing through a real modal runtime dialog.
Arbitrary Appearance=Flat controls without verified graphical owner-draw protocol.
